title: ÆTHER: pro humming layer for Sway v5 take 2
story: A fresh, breezy morning: the same six-part journey and steady 6/8 sway Jithesh liked in First Love v7, now as a refreshing track, not a romance.

brief.notes: A cappella wordless humming layer to mix under v5 take 2 (A major, 120 BPM). Long held, simple notes on the A major home chord so it sits on any chord in the track. Jithesh 09:35. v2, Jithesh 10:00: the v6 humming 'sounds very basic, like amateur musicians or a singer'. Ask for a top professional playback singer with Carnatic training, expressive and polished, female lead only.

prompt: A cappella only: NO instruments, no drums, no music bed at all, only one voice. A world-class professional South Indian film playback singer, Carnatic-trained, like the finest female voices of Tamil and Telugu cinema, hums a wordless melody (soft mmm, opening into a sweet aah): effortless, perfectly in tune, expressive and confident, a warm, rich, velvety tone with natural breath, graceful gamakam slides, quick grace-note turns, delicate vibrato only on long notes, and a sense of smiling tenderness. A polished, intimate, professional studio recording, close microphone, natural and dry, no echo, no reverb tail, no effects, no words, no lyrics, no backing vocals, no choir, no percussion. A major, exactly 120 BPM, steady time from the first second; each phrase is four bars long (8 seconds) with a soft breath before the next, like a singer floating a beautiful melody over a love song: phrases built on A, C sharp, E and F sharp, rising gently and settling home on A.
